Full financing stack closed: construction-to-term debt (ING Capital, Feb 2026) + $130M tax equity (Greenprint Capital, Jun 2026). Finance-to-COD window ~17 months (Feb 2026 → Q3 2027) is tight but executable for a utility-scale solar project with EPC already contracted.
History of 5 COD drifts totaling ~3 years (original 2024-08-30, current 2027-10-01) indicates schedule risk is real. The project has slipped an average of ~7 months per revision.

No construction_start milestone in ERCOT queue through Jun 2026, despite JV announcement saying 'begin construction in 2025' — this is a negative signal. Either construction started but wasn't reported, or it started later than communicated.

Positive signals: 20-yr PPA with Fortune 100 signed, EPC contracted, full finance stack closed by Jun 2026 — multiple committed parties with financial stakes in the schedule. Independent estimate 2027-Q4 adds one quarter to account for the pattern of prior slippage and unverified construction stage.
